The arc ran: critical-review gate (no report existed for ancora, so a fresh 9-persona review ran), rebase (no-op, main is a direct ancestor), then local CI preflight against BOTH matrix legs. Preflight found two blockers, so the pipeline stopped before /open-pr per Stop condition 7.

BLOCKER 1 - deterministic. mix spec.check --base ecc5e24 (main) exits non-zero: spec.check result=fail tier=branch errors=0 warnings=1, on ancora.review derived/growth. CI smoke runs that exact command for a PR into main, so the PR would be red 100% of runs. Cause: .spec/specs/ancora.review.spec.md changed by exactly one line on this branch (status draft -> active) while ~1000 lines of review code landed. The tool is correct; the contract was never substantively updated. Filed as ancora-ayj.
